title: Polished Nickel Towel Bar, 30-Inch Wall Mount Solid Brass Straight Bar, Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
description: Towel bar, 30-inch wall mount straight bar for bathroom towel storage, made from solid brass with concealed screw mounting for a clean traditional look — available in Polished Nickel that which offers a softer, warmer alternative to chrome with a subtle golden undertone that suits transitional spaces. Size: 30 Inch; center-to-center 30 in; bar diameter 0.75 in. Wall-mounted design saves space and keeps towels accessible. Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and all installation hardware; uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws. Supports up to 10 lb when properly installed. Available in multiple designer finish options and covered by a Limited Lifetime Warranty. Ideal for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories, and for matching Carolina pieces in the Carolina collection. Allied Brass Carolina Collection.
